messages.content: I'm planning a series of long weekend getaways for the upcoming year and I need to know when they'll occur in my country. Could you fetch me the list of long weekends for Canada in the year 2023? I'd like to integrate this information into my holiday planning app.

function.name: connectBluetooth
function.description: Establishes a connection to a Bluetooth device using its name. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

device_name.description: The name of the Bluetooth device to connect to.

timeout.description: The number of seconds to attempt a connection before timing out.

auto_reconnect.description: Whether to automatically attempt to reconnect if the connection is lost.

message.content:
Here’s a quick rundown of the public holidays that create long weekends in Canada for 2023 (these are the federal holidays; provincial variations may add or shift dates):

| Date | Holiday | Notes |
|------|---------|-------|
| **January 1** | New Year’s Day | Falls on Sunday – observed Monday, Jan 2 |
| **February 20** | Family Day (Alberta, British Columbia, Ontario, Saskatchewan) | Observed on the third Monday of February |
| **April 7** | Good Friday | Creates a long weekend with Easter Monday (observed on April 10) |
| **May 22** | Victoria Day | Celebrated on the last Monday before May 25 |
| **July 1** | Canada Day | Falls on Saturday – observed Monday, July 3 |
| **September 4** | Labour Day | Last Monday in September |
| **October 9** | Thanksgiving | Second Monday in October |
| **November 11** | Remembrance Day | Falls on Thursday – creates a long weekend with Veterans Day (observed on Nov 12) |

These dates will give you the main long‑weekend opportunities across Canada for 2023. If you’re targeting a specific province, let me know and I can adjust the list accordingly!
